request: Restore SCM PO link controls for STREQ-000133 after an SCM stock update on an SO-linked Backorder.
scenarios: An active Backorder with a linked SO and reviewed open materials permits SCM to link an existing PO when stock updates reset Sales decisions to pending.
Without a linked SO, every open material still requires Sales acceptance before either order may be linked.
A linked SO never bypasses missing stock checks, explicit request_update decisions, or all-resolved material protection.
The SO link rule is unchanged; invalid order kinds are rejected.
The real SCM page shows a visible PO field and button after a stock update; submitting the form successfully links the canonical PO.
Linking preserves pending Sales decisions, existing SO, native orders, revision protection, role access, and audit records.
Closed/completed cases and already linked POs never expose a new PO link form.
Other Backorder, stocking conversion and Special manual linking behavior remains covered by its existing suites.

failureModel.prematureLink: Negative property and HTTP tests for missing SO, missing checks and request_update; persisted identity used by server.
failureModel.uiServerMismatch: Real browser submit and authenticated HTTP regression.
failureModel.lostWrites: Existing concurrent revision tests plus stale-revision regression.
failureModel.remoteWrites: Existing integration fetch trap and native order snapshot comparison.
failureModel.deploymentDrift: One runtime file over captured live image, all runtime hashes and config checked before and after; automatic rollback on failure.

setup.git: Preserve existing changes; no commits or reset.
setup.testEnvironment: Existing Node, fast-check, Playwright, c8, ESLint and TypeScript; standard isolated Compose, mbbs-tests.slice, bounded services; teardown registered before startup.
setup.database: Synthetic disposable test DB; no production data edits or migration.
